name: continua-memory-workspace
description: Continua Memory & Workspace gives Claude and your agents persistent, versioned memory and a shared workspace in Continua Project Rooms. Remember decisions, conventions, and session context across sessions, machines, and teammates; hand off long-running and multi-agent work through a write-ahead log with conflict checks; research large technical corpora such as API docs, RFCs, specs, and logs with file and line citations using up to 1B tokens of working context; build a cited data dictionary and metric glossary for text-to-SQL and analytics; and generate grounded eval sets for RAG and agents. Every file is an immutable, restorable version. Connects to the Continua Project Room MCP server (https://app.askcontinua.com/mcp?subset=mini) and requires a Continua account; access and usage follow your account permissions and plan.
